name: ETH 1.5x
status: in force from 2026-10-16 once the inception decision 2026-10-16-qeth15-paper-inception is anchored (see decisions.jsonl) — stage A: a rules-only synthetic level of a daily-reset 1.5x book from Binance spot bars, one line per UTC day; nothing is borrowed, swapped or liquidated, and no vault follows the level yet.
_doc: Stage A rules for ETH 1.5x (keeper/leverage-index.mjs). The rulebook is rulebooks/qeth15.md in this repository; the inception decision pins this file's sha256. check.minutes and check.trigger are the output of the pre-registered ETH 1.5x daily-reset test (site repository, registration commit d7fec51, result row trk_asset_outcome,ETH,A,miss1,all: sole survivor of the filter, ETH|1.5|daily|L>=2.3|15) on the 'miss one check' track, which the owner chose on 2026-10-13 after the results. The product definition (target 1.5, daily reset at 00:00 UTC, back to 1.5 after a trigger, no intraday re-leverage) was set by the owner on 2026-10-13: the 2x definition, at 1.5. The values hold for stage A only: a real borrowing book needs a new verdict against the real liquidation line. Changing any value after a decision pinned this file is a rule change: a new decision, never an edit.

underlying._doc: As qETH2X: closed 1-minute bars of the UTC day, aggregated to 15-minute bars by the test engines' --build rule; no fallback source; a day with fewer than 1,440 bars halts until a person accepts it in keeper/leverage-gaps.json.

product._doc: Product definition (owner 2026-10-13: the 2x definition, at 1.5): one and a half times the UTC-day return of ETH, leverage brought back to 1.5 at every 00:00 UTC close; between resets the trigger only reduces leverage, back to 1.5.

check._doc: ETH 1.5x test output, 'miss one check' track (a variant qualifies only if the margin holds with the unchecked window doubled to 30 minutes), chosen by the owner on 2026-10-13 after the results: chosen ETH|1.5|daily|L>=T|n = ETH|1.5|daily|L>=2.3|15. The free track returns 15 minutes and 2.4. Check times are every 15 minutes from 00:00 UTC, i.e. every bar close.

model.lltvNote: placeholder, as qETH2X and as the ETH 1.5x test — no market's value is confirmed; the tests count a liquidation at a bar low at this LTV as a total loss

level._doc: The cost convention of the recorded level, set by the owner on 2026-10-13 — the same convention as qBTC2X (30 bp, 4.5% a year; the test's headline is 6%): costBp per unit of traded notional, charged out of equity at each trade; at every 15-minute bar the debt is multiplied by (1 + ratePct / 100 / 365) ^ (elapsed minutes / 1440). level.also = further conventions recorded on the same line, each with its own book (none).

fees._doc: 1% a year (owner, 2026-10-13): a price, not a tested value, and it can only be lowered. It is not applied to the stage A level (the published level is before the fee) and nothing collects it — there is no vault. This key records the decision and drives nothing.
